title: DOE-UAP-D003, Pajarito Astronomers Invitation, 1986
what_is_it: A letter inviting members of the Pajarito Astronomers club to a meeting featuring a UFO-related presentation by a Los Alamos National Laboratory-affiliated physicist.
interpretation_warnings: No body text was extractable from this scanned image; all facts are derived from the CSV metadata description provided by war.gov.
The document is a club invitation, not an official government report or investigation record.
The presentation was by a LANL-affiliated individual acting in a personal capacity, not representing the laboratory.
The content of Dr. Warren's actual presentation is unknown — only the title survives in the record.
